pages.text: Refined Storage allows you to extend your network over long distances using wireless components. This guide explains how to set up and maintain long-distance network connections.

Required Components:$(li)Network Transmitter - Sends signals$(li)Network Receiver - Receives signals$(li)Network Card - Enables wireless functionality$(li)Range Upgrades - Extends transmission distance

Setup Process:$(li)Place Network Transmitter in source network$(li)Place Network Receiver in target network$(li)Configure both with matching channel$(li)Install Network Cards in wireless devices$(li)Add Range Upgrades to increase distance

Best Practices:$(li)Use Range Upgrades for longer distances$(li)Keep networks within chunk loading range$(li)Configure security settings if needed$(li)Monitor power consumption$(li)Use multiple transmitters for redundancy
